text: GET FULL VERSION - MORE DETAILED MapPS

summarization: This smartphone UI screen displays a map of South America, showing various countries and their borders. The map includes country names and major cities. At the top of the screen, there is an advertisement banner for McDonald's, promoting an app installation. Below the advertisement, there is a prompt to get a full version of the app for more detailed maps. The bottom of the screen features navigation controls, including a zoom-in and zoom-out button, allowing users to adjust the map's scale. The screen also has a menu icon in the top right corner, likely providing additional options or settings.
